title: Recorded point-power compositors and signed Roos coherence data
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, a prime l and finite extension E/Q_l as in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Use the recursive point powers, whole strict coefficient systems, exact pullbacks and recorded insertion transports of [lem-trf-point-system-transport-descent], and exact scalar restriction and total inverse limit of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define F_r,Fc_r,Ft_r,Uc,Gc from these functors. Define signed coordinates on the strict shifted Roos cone of [def-weil-strict-roos-model] by composing its roosχ with biproduct braiding and the sign on the second factor. Compositors consists of natural isomorphisms d_m:F_m followed by F_1 to F_{m+1}, t_m:G_m followed by G_1 to G_{m+1}, b_r:U followed by Ft_r to G_r followed by U, and the finite tensor compositor. Define HasSiteSections, HasSystemSections and HasRestrictionSections to require identity on every underlying section, and HasTensorUnits to require multiplication of successive inserted tensor units through the recorded comparison j of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. RoosNormalization consists of the projection-normalized ordinary-limit comparison, its K-injective-normalized right-derived unit, and theta from that total inverse limit to the actual Roos model sending the unit to roosι. Comparisons consists of the product, cone and derived comparisons psi,kappa,a for all powers. Define HasProducts by its original product projections, HasFirstCoordinate and HasSecondCoordinate by the two signed diagonal equations, and HasDerivedModel by conjugation through theta and the exact derived factors. Define u and I by the recorded chain and derived transports and their canonical composition factors. StrictTransportCoherence, DerivedTransportCoherence, ProductCoherence, ConeCoherence and DerivedComparisonCoherence are the composition equations for these five comparisons with d and t. All constructions are the definitions formerly in PointSystemPowerRoosCoherence, verbatim, without any assertion that the specified witnesses exist.
